date_label: Married when de Gramont was twenty-one; year not stated in the source read
summary: De Gramont's marriage, and the source of the title she is usually named by. Souhami reports her speaking of her husband as a cruel gaoler.
certainty_reasoning: MARRIED: a legal marriage, stated by a biographer. It is on the map under the roster's spouse rule, which admits every documented spouse so that a woman's marriage is visible beside her other attachments rather than hidden inside her file.

sources.quote: At twenty-one she married the Marquis Philibert de Clermont-Tonnerre, a reactionary, dictatorial man who tried to bend her to his views. She spoke of him as a cruel gaoler.
sources.context: Souhami, in the chapter 'Lily de Gramont', immediately after describing de Gramont's upbringing.
sources.supports: The marriage, the husband's name, and de Gramont's own reported view of it.
sources.provenance: Repo PDF page 98; printed folio 72 confirmed on the rendered page image, read 2026-08-05.
